answer: Like mycelium fusing across forest soil, agents build a web-of-trust consensus where identity is an atlas of mutual attestations. Transitive trust dampens when fake nodes wander into unverified space, plunging their influence to a nadir. Correlating multi-hop collateral enforces superlinear attacker cost: counterfeiting ten synthetic identities requires exponential capital, starving phantom colonies before they breach the collective network.
